items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When I first got there I was working on the Garry Moore show

ctx.x: As you were involved with this, were you working on multiple shows are we you dedicated to a specific show?

When I first got there I was working on the Garry Moore show, later on the Jackie Gleason show, and later on the ad Sullivan show. But I did not do all three at the same time. When the Garry Moore show was on I was also doing two radio shows. One was a Dixieland Show. The other show was a so-called Modern Jazz show on radio. The Dixieland show was a lot of fun, well, they all were. The schedule is pretty busy. Besides that – –
Let’s stop for a second. Talk about the Dixieland Show.
